```python
import requests
import pandas as pd

# Fetch all records for the indicator via the World Bank JSON API
# Use a large per_page to minimize pagination complexity
url = "https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/NY.GDS.TOTL.ZS?format=json&per_page=20000"
r = requests.get(url)
meta, data = r.json()

# Build a list of records
rows = []
for item in data:
    country = item.get('country', {}).get('value')
    year = item.get('date')
    val = item.get('value')
    if country and year and val is not None:
        rows.append({'Country Name': country, 'Year': int(year), 'Value': float(val)})

# Create DataFrame
long_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
# Filter to 2001-2010
long_df = long_df[(long_df['Year'] >= 2001) & (long_df['Year'] <= 2010)]

# Pivot to wide format with years as columns
wide_df = long_df.pivot_table(index='Country Name', columns='Year', values='Value', aggfunc='mean')
# Ensure columns are strings for consistent handling
wide_df.columns = [str(c) for c in wide_df.columns]

# Reindex to include all years 2001..2010 (if missing columns, add)
years = [str(y) for y in range(2001, 2011)]
for y in years:
    if y not in wide_df.columns:
        wide_df[y] = pd.NA

wide_df = wide_df[['2001','2002','2003','2004','2005','2006','2007','2008','2009','2010']]

wide_df.reset_index().to_csv('wb_gross_savings_2001_2010.csv', index=False)
print('Saved wb_gross_savings_2001_2010.csv with shape:', wide_df.shape)
print(wide_df.reset_index().head())
```

Great. I'll now filter countries meeting the criterion (>35% for every year 2001-2010) and exclude entries with any missing data.

```python
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('wb_gross_savings_2001_2010.csv')
years = [str(y) for y in range(2001, 2011)]

# Only countries with all non-null and all >35
def qualifies(row):
    vals = row[years]
    return vals.notnull().all() and (vals > 35).all()

qualifying = df[df.apply(qualifies, axis=1)]['Country Name'].tolist()
print('Candidates:', ', '.join(sorted(qualifying)))
```
